noticeEn: For this VP - V4 Staging acceptance run with owned synthetic accounts only. Public Bailian terms name Tongyi Yunqi (Hangzhou) Information Technology Co., Ltd.; this account's contracting entity and accepted terms version remain unverified. VisePanda retains the question and validated answer long term with no automatic deletion date. Deleting a chat or account permanently hides retained text in the product; it is not erasure. Withdrawing this policy's consent stops future authorization and result storage, but cannot recall a request already sent or erase supplier copies. Declining means no model call. Do not enter passwords, codes, card numbers, secret keys, or private information about others. Contact jtcao@go2china.space for questions or an erasure request; a request does not establish completion.
